Package org.apache.juneau.bean.openapi3

Class OpenApiCopyUtils

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.CopyUtils
org.apache.juneau.bean.openapi3.OpenApiCopyUtils
public class OpenApiCopyUtils extends CopyUtils
Copy utilities for the OpenAPI 3.0 bean module.

Extends CopyUtils so that a single static-import-on-demand of this class (import static org.apache.juneau.bean.openapi3.OpenApiCopyUtils.*;) brings in both the inherited collection/map/array copyOf(...) overloads and the OpenAPI bean copyOf(<BeanType>) overloads declared here, resolved via ordinary Java overload resolution.
